# Clinika — full reference for LLMs

> Clinika (https://www.clinika.health) is a bilingual (Spanish/English) practice-management platform for dental clinics: scheduling, online booking, patient records with interactive odontogram, treatment plans, inventory, billing and a patient portal in one web app. Built for Latin America — Spanish-first, WhatsApp-native reminders, and El Salvador DTE electronic invoicing on the top plan. 14-day free trial on every plan, no credit card required. Contact: team@clinika.health.

## What Clinika is

Clinika is software-as-a-service for dental clinics and independent dentists. A clinic signs up in minutes, configures its name, hours and services, and immediately gets:

1. A private dashboard for the team: appointments, patient records, inventory and settings.
2. A public profile page at `https://www.clinika.health/c/{clinic-slug}` showing services, photos, hours and location, where patients book an appointment online in seconds without creating an account.
3. A patient portal where patients review their upcoming visits, treatment history and records.

The interface is fully bilingual: Spanish is the default and English can be toggled anywhere in the app. Date formats and content follow the selected language.

## Who it is for

- Dental clinics in El Salvador and the broader Latin American market
- Independent dentists who want online booking without building a website
- Multi-doctor practices that need commission tracking and role separation (including a restricted "reception mode")
- Clinics that must issue DTE electronic invoices to El Salvador's Ministerio de Hacienda

## Feature detail

### Scheduling
- Calendar of appointments with double-booking prevention
- Token / queue system for walk-ins
- Appointment reminders over WhatsApp (quota depends on plan)
- Cancellations and reschedules tracked on the dashboard

### Online booking (public clinic profile)
- Every clinic gets a shareable page: services, photo gallery, doctor bio, opening hours, phone, address and an embedded map (with exact pin support)
- Patients pick an available slot from the clinic's real schedule; conflicts are blocked server-side
- No patient account is required to book; bookings can be managed via a manage-booking link

### Patient records
- Full clinical ficha per patient (history, allergies, notes)
- Interactive odontogram with treatment plans
- Patient treatment timeline
- Digital informed consent, MINSAL compliant
- Digital prescription PDF generator (CSSP/DCI fields)
- CSV patient import that adapts to different column formats (single name column or separate first/last name columns)

### Inventory
- Stock levels with low-stock and out-of-stock alerts
- Treatment-linked deductions: supplies decrement automatically when treatments are performed (Profesional and above)

### Billing & finance
- Treatment-linked budgeting tool for patient quotes
- Doctor commission calculator; multi-doctor commission tracking on the top plan
- Hacienda-Ready plan: full DTE pipeline for El Salvador — invoice JSON → digital signature → Hacienda API → UUID, storage of the Sello de Recepción, Wompi payment-link integration, and a 10-year document archive for fiscal compliance

### Patient portal
- Patients sign in (WhatsApp OTP access on Profesional and above) to see appointments, treatments and history

### Platform
- Subscriptions billed monthly through Stripe; upgrade, downgrade or cancel anytime from Settings → Manage billing
- Authentication and per-clinic data isolation: each clinic can only access its own information, enforced at the database level (row-level security)
- Encryption in transit; light and dark mode; responsive web app

## Frequently asked questions

**Do I need a card to try Clinika?**
No. The 14-day trial requires no credit card. You only pay when you decide to continue.

**Can my patients book online?**
Yes. Your clinic gets a public page with your schedule; patients pick an open slot and book in seconds, no account needed.

**Is my data secure?**
Yes. Each clinic can only access its own information, protected with authentication and encryption in transit.

**Can I cancel anytime?**
Yes. Change plans or cancel from Settings → Manage billing, with no lock-in or penalties.
